fn process_items(items: &[Item]) -> f64 {
    // GOOD: chain iterator with fold, no intermediate Vec allocation
    let (total, count) = items
        .iter()
        .filter(|i| i.in_stock)
        .map(|i| i.price)
        .fold((0.0_f64, 0_usize), |(sum, cnt), price| (sum + price, cnt + 1));

    total / count as f64
}

struct Item {
    name: String,
    price: f64,
    in_stock: bool,
}
